mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deepening labor market crisis that triggers equity sell-offs due to recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) indicate a 'soft landing' monetary policy that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth), a sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% accelerates equity market declines due to deteriorating corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% and GDPC1 is negative for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 600,000 units) indicates robust consumer spending and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output contraction (INDPRO below 95.0) signals weakening industrial activity that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 600,000 units) indicate a strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05).
